device: iPhone 16 Pro Max (440x956 pt @ 3x = 1320x2868 px raw)

screenshots.title: Welcome to JobMatch
screenshots.caption: Start your job search with transparent match scores built for Biñan and Laguna.

screenshots.title: Create your account
screenshots.caption: Enter your full name, email, and an 8+ character password to create your account.

screenshots.title: Choose account type
screenshots.caption: Pick "I am looking for a job" to start your personal job matching and career plan.

screenshots.title: Onboarding – Skills (categorized picker)
screenshots.caption: Browse 300+ categorized skills, pick Suggested for you, and set your level for each skill.

screenshots.title: Onboarding – Résumé auto-fill result
screenshots.caption: Tap Update All Info to auto-fill skills, education, and summary while keeping personal details protected.

screenshots.title: Onboarding – Goals & work setups
screenshots.caption: Pick your target career role, accepted work setups (On-site, Hybrid, Remote), and pay goal.

screenshots.title: Your profile
screenshots.caption: Complete your circular profile photo, 3:4 portrait, and details to reach 100% profile strength.

screenshots.title: Discover – matched job card
screenshots.caption: Swipe right to save, left to pass, up to star, or tap any card to see your full match breakdown.

screenshots.title: Discover – Filter jobs
screenshots.caption: Filter jobs by commute limit, work setup (On-site, Hybrid, Remote), employment type, area, and minimum pay.

screenshots.title: Upcoming interview on Discover
screenshots.caption: Scheduled interviews appear at the top of Discover so you can review details and tap Confirm in one tap.

screenshots.title: Job details & match breakdown
screenshots.caption: See exactly how your skills (55%), location (20%), interests (15%), and pay (10%) build your match score.

screenshots.title: Career breakdown for a job
screenshots.caption: Check your readiness ring, learning progress, and exact skills needed for any job listing.

screenshots.title: Career roadmap & career path
screenshots.caption: Follow weekly Learn and Practice tasks, pass skill quizzes, and track your Entry-to-Senior career path.

screenshots.title: Résumé review results
screenshots.caption: Get an instant score, strong areas, specific fixes with examples, and employer-appeal tips.

screenshots.title: Applications & status timeline
screenshots.caption: Track every application from Applied to Shortlisted or Hired, plus employer view status and Insights.

screenshots.title: Matches – contact details shared
screenshots.caption: Once shortlisted, employer contact details appear and a direct chat opens.

screenshots.title: Messages – long-press options
screenshots.caption: Press and hold any message to Reply, Copy, Edit, Unsend, or Remove for you.

screenshots.title: Employer overview dashboard
screenshots.caption: Employers see live jobs, applicants, matches, views, and upcoming interviews in one dashboard.

screenshots.title: Post a job
screenshots.caption: Employers pick a career role, work setup (On-site, Hybrid, or Remote), 4:3 photo, and required skills.

screenshots.title: Employer jobs list
screenshots.caption: Every live listing shows work setup, pay range, status, and total applicant count.

screenshots.title: Ranked applicants with match scores
screenshots.caption: Applicants are ranked by fit with masked names until the employer chooses to shortlist.

screenshots.title: Applicant review drawer
screenshots.caption: Employers review skills, work setups, education, and summary fairly—contact details appear only after shortlisting.

screenshots.title: Schedule interview modal
screenshots.caption: Once shortlisted, employers schedule an Online or On-site interview and send an instant invite.

screenshots.title: Candidate search & invites
screenshots.caption: Employers can discover opted-in seekers matched to their open roles and invite them to apply.

screenshots.title: Employer analytics
screenshots.caption: Hiring trends, views, saves, and application rates help employers improve their job listings.

screenshots.title: Verified company profile
screenshots.caption: Every employer completes document verification to earn the Verified badge shown to seekers.

screenshots.title: Messages with a candidate
screenshots.caption: Employers chat directly with shortlisted candidates using quick replies and message tools.
